_doc: Per-test overrides + denominator ratchet for the node-suite harness. Default = a test is runnable. Add { "skip": true, "reason": "...", "category": "known_issues"|"flaky"|"" } ONLY for genuinely-unrunnable tests (native addon, internals flag, platform-N/A). 'ratchet' caps the discretionary skip count -- the one denominator lever oam controls. maxSkips should only ever be LOWERED; raising it is a reviewable diff and node-suite exits non-zero (CI fails) if the actual skip count exceeds it. Auto-detected unrunnables (// Flags, missing node: builtin) are NOT counted against the ratchet.
